evidence_rules: 1955–1958 uses an explicit low-confidence pre-association baseline derived from the ITF-recorded 1959 foundation year.
Tonga Tennis Association identity begins in 1959 and is not backcast.
2024 East Pacific junior participation and 2026 current federation/development-officer evidence are separately gated.

No rankings or event outcomes are calibration targets.
